nodes.value:
fun {M} {W} val_m val_w mu =>
  (∀ (m : M), 0 ≤ EconCSLib.Matching.valM val_m m (mu.m_match m)) ∧
    (∀ (w : W), 0 ≤ EconCSLib.Matching.valW val_w w (mu.w_match w)) ∧
      ∀ (m : M) (w : W),
        EconCSLib.Matching.valM val_m m (mu.m_match m) < val_m m w →
          EconCSLib.Matching.valW val_w w (mu.w_match w) < val_w w m → False
